[b]The Astorian Journal[/b]

The country recently had parlementary elections. The results have been released today but... Elnire got into a situation where it never was before.

[spoiler= The election results]
[b]72%[/b] of the person who can vote voted (voting is compulsory here)

[b]Socialist Party[/b]: 24% of the votes (63/300 seats)

[b]Liberal Party[/b]: 31% of the votes (93/300 seats)

[b]Christian Democrats[/b]: 14% of the votes (42/300 seats)

[b]Conservative Party[/b]: 34% of the votes (102/300 seats)

(These numbers don't take into account the so called "nothing vote" which were at 32%)

To be able to do pretty much anything, you need half the seats plus one (151 seats) to agree with what you're doing. So, the ruling coalition, is a coalition called [b]"The Left"[/b] composed of the [b]Liberal Party[/b] and the [b]Socialist Party[/b] (whose seats add up to 156).
[/spoiler]

[spoiler= The situation]
The Elnirean Constitution of 1774 states that "The Prime Minister shall be chosen by the Monarch and be from the ruling party or coalition in the Parlement". This article never posed problem because the biggest party was either already rulling, or in the ruling coalition. But today, the biggest party (the "Conservative Party") isn't in the ruling coalition ("The Left").

The King has to appoint a prime minister, but he doesn't know from which side of the political spectrum shall be the prime minister and everyone is confused on how a so ambiguous article was written in the constitution. Each side wants a prime minister from their side (I know surprising right?). 

The constitutional council was informed of the situation and the whole country is waiting for a response. [/spoiler]
